experiences.position: Practice Manager - Sales, Professional Services - Software Vertical
experiences.description:
Overview: 
- Partner with NetSuite’s Sales and Solution Consulting teams to sell NetSuite Professional Services solutions to new, direct customers within the Software Vertical.
- Manage a team of experienced Solution Principals that assist the Sales team in scoping, developing, presenting, and closing of professional services engagements with new and existing customers.
- Accountable for achieving quarterly revenue and bookings targets. 
- Maintain and enhance NetSuite's PS Sales infrastructure including methods, processes, templates and tools. 

Responsibilities:

Achieve and Exceed PS Bookings and Revenue targets 
•	Optimize management of PS pipeline to ensure attainment of quarterly bookings targets.
•	Support attainment of quarter revenue targets by delivering high quality PS contracts/SOWs and by ensuring proper knowledge transfer to NetSuite delivery teams. 
•	Attain quarterly PS revenue targets

Increase the Value of the NetSuite Application for Customers 
•	Partner with Account Management and Client Management teams to promote user adoption and effective use of NetSuite products to support renewal efforts
•	Assist customers with mapping their budget & priorities to the scope and deployment strategy
•	Meet with prospective NetSuite customers and articulate the value proposition, commitment, and capabilities of NetSuite professional services

Manage and develop team of Solution Principals
•	Develop and manage a high-performing professional services sales team.
•	Allocate sales opportunities effectively to optimize performance. 
•	Continually assess and develop skills for solution principals.

Maintain and enhance PS Sales best practices infrastructure.
•	Continually assess and identify improvements to PS Sales methods, processes, templates, and tools.
•	Develop strong relationships with key leaders in the NetSuite Sales and Solution Consulting organizations.
•	Interact frequently with other PS Sales Practice Managers to share best practices.

.Held Senior Consultant position from October 2008 to July 2012 

•Conduct business process mapping and requirements gathering sessions with new customers to determine configuration requirements both on-site and remote – specializing in software companies 
•Prepare the Business Requirements and Technical Scoping Documents resulting from  the above noted mapping sessions to provide proposed solutions for the requirements for customer approval 
•Manage all aspects of the configuration process for the customer from configuration through to acceptance and sign-off
•Provide project management for customers purchasing Accelerated implementations  
•Troubleshoot issues that arise during configuration sessions
•Direct, oversee, mentor and develop junior consultants and offshore resources

Responsible for all Professional Services Sales activities for Software, Services and Advertising Media and Publishing verticals at NetSuite.  Manage the day to day responsibilities of the 8 Solution Principals who provide scoping and pricing for implementations.

experiences.position: Director, Support Service and Product Management
experiences.description:
Key in the growth of AAL from a 12-person Canadian-focused organization with 1.2 million in sales to a 180-person organization with 26 million in sales and a US/Australia focus.  Key contributor to this growth by leveraging the blended perspective of an entrepreneur and a corporate leader to the company.

Set goals and directions of organization; formulated plans for growth; qualified strengths and weaknesses; provided input as the liaison for the AAL Client Advisory Committee that represented an elected user group.  Managed all issues and communications with clients.

Built and managed the departments of Product Support, Sales Support, Implementation and Training, Product Management and End User Documentation.  Responsibilities included individual department objectives, action plans, staffing, and budgets.  Successfully recruited 75+ employees to all departments; created integration, training and certification programs for rapid deployment of new employees; promoted many to management positions within the company.  Retained 99% of staff hired.  Created compensation plans, performance review policies and promotion strategies corporate-wide.
